The '''man-o'-war body armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] developed by the [[Iskalonian]]s. It contained two blunt horns at the top of the head which housed various sensors and wireless devices, as well as a golden visor to cover the eyes of the wearer. In addition, the armor was sturdy enough to survive the detonation of a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] with little damage, and could deflect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots. It was considered extremely rare by the time of [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].

The [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Kosh Kurp]] managed to acquire a [[crimson]]-colored set during the two decades he spent hunting down [[Suppoon|Sonopo Bomoor]] as well as studying various weapons on his quest for vengeance against the latter for killing off his entire family during the [[Massacre of Bonaka Nueno]] on his homeworld of [[Intuci]].
